title: Coquina Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: With a great location on Savannah Street this two bedroom cottage offers comfort, class, and convenience with it's prime Seaside location only a 4 minute walk to the beach with private Savannah Street pavilion
description_expanded: Home currently undergoing a complete gut re-model! Should be back to the rental market summer 2026 as a COMPLETELY different and larger home. Larger square footage with more bedrooms (now 3), more baths and a larger kitchen-- custom designed! New New New!!! HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Beach access to the Private Seaside beach via the Savannah Pavilion - Up to 6 (may increase to 8) Wrist Bands TOTAL for private beach access (per Seaside guidelines they will not provide us with more bands than the home sleeps) - Two beach cruiser bikes - Optional access to Seaside's private pools and fitness center (additional fee applies) - Dual Queen spacious bedrooms with cable TV - Fully stocked kitchen - Walking distance to the Seaside shops, restaurants and amenities - Optional access to the Swim and Fitness Center - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) Coquina features dual master QUEEN bedrooms! They both are very spacious with private closets, mounted 32" flat screen HDTV's and each have their own private access to a shared outdoor balcony! These rooms share the one of two full bathrooms. Upstairs bathroom is a shower only while the downstairs bathroom has a tub/shower combo. Double gallery porches cool you with ceiling fans, rockers, a swing, and Adirondack chairs. The third-floor tower offers a 3rd bedroom option complete with brand new daybed with trundle to sleep 2 comfortably. The tower is accessible by a normal staircase making this a wonderful additional sleeping space and the best place to enjoy views of Seaside and the Gulf. Open the tower’s French doors, step out onto one of the two decks, and watch the sun set. On the main level, Coquina offers an open living room with pull-out sofa, 46" flat screen HDTV/Blue Ray, plantation shutters, and additional seating. Also on the first floor is a fully equipped kitchen, dining space with seating for 6, and the second full bathroom with shower only. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (sleeps 8) 1st floor- Pull out queen sofa, TV, Kitchen, Dining, Full bath with tub/shower combo 2nd floor- Bedroom 1: Queen, TV, outdoor balcony access Shared hall bath with shower only Bedroom 2: Queen, TV, outdoor balcony access Bedroom 3: TBD 3rd floor- Tower with a daybed and trundle Out the back door is an outdoor shower and grill that you can share with guest cottage, Creole. If you are in need of a little more room, Creole (VRBO 291904), is the 2-bedroom guest cottage right next door. Seaside was named one of the Top 12 Destinations worldwide by Frommer’s 2010 and our property is part of the collection that received an 98% guest satisfaction score last season! Come and see why! IMPORTANT DETAILS * Parking for 2 cars * Sorry, no pets allowed **There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. **Must be 25 to rent *Seaside amenities: Playground, Pickleball Courts, Tennis Courts, Croquet Lawn, Basketball, 3 community pools including a covered pool, Adult only pool and Family pool, Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
